test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Over the years, the threat of cyberattacks on satellites has gotten more direr.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **has gotten more direr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace "**direr**" with "**dire**" to correct the sentence.
 
• **Dire **means extremely serious or urgent.
 
 
• **Example -** *Misuse of drugs can have dire consequences.*
 
 
 
• We use "**more**" to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else.
 
• In the given sentence there is a comparison between past years and the current scenario.
 
• **More **is a comparative form. Also, "Direr" is the comparative degree of "dire"
 
• The use of two comparatives together is incorrect.
 
• Therefore, only one comparative form should be used.
 
• So, "dire" will be used in place of "direr".

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2** which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:** *Over the years, the threat of cyberattacks on satellites has gotten more dire.*
